verdict.rationale: n8n is a workflow automation tool whose workflows start from event triggers. The evidence shows a Webhook trigger node, an MCP Server Trigger, and error workflows that run automatically when an execution fails. Hands-on users confirm scheduled and webhook-initiated tasks (n8n-comm-18) and event-driven monitor-analyze-notify flows (n8n-comm-7). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of conditional rule/filter logic within triggered workflows, and in-depth trigger documentation beyond node page titles (e.g., app-event and schedule trigger details).
